topm-01-c2.text: Markus König, Steffen Wiedmann, Christoph Brüne, Andreas Roth, Hartmut Buhmann, Laurens W. Molenkamp, Xiao-Liang Qi, Shou-Cheng Zhang (2007). Quantum Spin Hall Insulator State in HgTe Quantum Wells. Science 318, 766–770.
topm-01-c2.quote: The quantum phase transition at the critical thickness, d = 6.3 nm,
topm-01-c2.claim: Thin wells inherit CdTe ordering (trivial), thick wells inherit HgTe ordering (topological), with a phase transition at dc ≈ 6.3 nm

topm-01-c3.text: Y. Xia, D. Qian, D. Hsieh, L. Wray, A. Pal, H. Lin, A. Bansil, D. Grauer, Y. S. Hor, R. J. Cava, M. Z. Hasan (2009). Observation of a large-gap topological-insulator class with a single Dirac cone on the surface. Nature Physics 5, 398–402.
topm-01-c3.quote: have nearly equal band velocities, approximately 5×10⁵ ms⁻¹, along the two directions
topm-01-c3.claim: a single Dirac cone inside the gap, dispersing as E = ℏvF|k| with vF ≈ 5 × 10⁵ m/s
